objective: Mechanically distinguish whether side-target proposal instability is more consistent with Draw-to-Side transitions or Side-to-Opposite-Side transitions, using a preregistered development family selection followed by an independent confirmation cohort.

data.cohort_guard: These 2022/23 and 2023/24 league-season rows were not used by the 2024/25-2025/26 external projection diagnostics in this line. Development and confirmation league sets are disjoint.

proxy_mapping.raw_side_proposal: opening Top1 differs from closing Top1 AND closing Top1 is H or A
proxy_mapping.family_DRAW_TO_SIDE_ONLY: execute only when opening Top1 is D and closing target is H or A
proxy_mapping.family_SIDE_TO_SIDE_ONLY: execute only when opening Top1 is H or A and closing target is the opposite H/A side
proxy_mapping.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening fallback

development_protocol.selection_rule: Among hard-gate-pass candidates choose highest global Top1; tie lower global LogLoss; tie DRAW_TO_SIDE_ONLY before SIDE_TO_SIDE_ONLY deterministically.
development_protocol.confirmation_open_rule: Open confirmation only if at least one nontrivial candidate passes every development hard gate.

interpretation_guards: This experiment studies proposal-source reliability, not market information for production.
No result can promote Formal V2, V3.1.1, V3.2.4 or Stage7.
If development selects a family, its identity is frozen before confirmation labels are evaluated.
If confirmation fails, no post-view mixture, threshold, league exception or fallback family is allowed.
The quarantined 2026/27 Big-5 97-match snapshot remains unopened.
